items.title: Nancy Wilson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] It was produced by Leroy Robinson...

ctx.x: they did their – they came and gave cookies, and he was trying out his recipes. So there was a lot of good stuff that came out of that.
It was produced by Leroy Robinson, directed by George Michael, who is now on 20/20, and I think Darlene Chan was involved.
I said Diane Louie. I meant Darlene Chan, who was my stage manager. Diane Louie writes music for me.
